name: coreutils
description_en: Cross-platform Rust rewrite of the GNU coreutils
readme_excerpt: uutils coreutils uutils coreutils is a cross-platform reimplementation of the GNU coreutils in Rust. While all programs have been implemented, some options might be missing or different behavior might be experienced. We provide prebuilt binaries, manpages, and shell completions from main branch at https://github.com/uutils/coreutils/releases/tag/latest-commit . The latest stable tag https://github.com/uutils/coreutils/releases/latest also exists for reproducible products and packagers. Bug repo…
